title: Origins: Slimeling
description: Origin datapack that adds the Slimeling, an origin based on the Slime.
body:
Origin datapack that adds the Slimeling, an origin based on the Slime.

Descendants of the blocky slimes, Slimelings are made out of the green substance and possess the ability to jump and bounce around to their heart's content.

![Slimeling Power List](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6f107b346a55166d72e78bb9fec4ef2a244d97b8.png)
